path_policy: Absolute paths use workspace_root as a prefix; rebase that prefix onto the assigned worktree. /** owns a subtree. A worker may also edit its own card, and no other coordination document.
readiness_rule: Dependencies require coordinator acceptance, merged verification and approved-SHA ancestry on origin/main; stale REVIEW/Pending cards do not block or require post-approval commits. A unique explicit user dispatch (T001 normalizes to T01) supplies READY/exclusive assignment unless ownership conflicts; DB/port leases remain explicit. See skill sections 1 and 7.

worktree_policy.primary_checkout: Coordinator supplies verified absolute PRIMARY; workers never edit its project files or run app installs/tests there.
worktree_policy.creation: Agent creates its exclusive worktree/branch from verified origin/main before edits. Coordinator publishes /.worktrees/ ignore rule before T00. Resume only verified owned state; collisions block.
worktree_policy.execution: Rebase all paths to WT; use explicit cwd there for edits, local dependencies, tests, commits and pushes. Git metadata and DB/ports remain shared.
worktree_policy.cleanup: After REVIEW handoff, passing checks, clean state, stopped owned processes, durable evidence and verified remote HEAD, agent uses git worktree remove without force. Inspect ignored artifacts first. Keep local/remote branches. Preserve worktree on blockers/conflicts/failure; never prune or delete others' work.

resource_locks.postgres-test: One coordinator-granted holder across all worktrees for migration, seed, reset, integration and E2E runs. Release after child processes stop. Default localhost:5433/stockflow_test is shared.
resource_locks.next-e2e: One holder for localhost:3100; acquired together with postgres-test. Never reuse another agent's server.
resource_locks.integration: Coordinator serializes merges into main and central dashboard updates. Workers push task branches only.
